fields: required String or Bool scalar fields only; no reference bindings

component_protocol.normalization: identity; no coercion, defaults, trimming or Unicode normalization
component_protocol.ownership: components formed privately after validation; frozen and tied to the module snapshot registry
component_protocol.equality: same owned concept and exact typed component values
component_protocol.hash: length-prefixed concept, field name, type tag and exact string value or Bool 1/0; canonical key, not cryptographic digest

validators.binding: generation-time declared Rule selector with exact closure and generated artifact digest
validators.arguments: explicit complete parameter-to-field mapping with exact scalar-type agreement
validators.value_object_base: exact set of authored invariant_refs, once each
validators.entity_base: one or more explicit Rule bindings; implementation bindings do not create graph edges
validators.order: authored base array then selected extension arrays in application order; stop at first failure
validators.failure: structured failure with null value and trace; no formed snapshot
validators.extensions: named generation-time declarations only; additive, immutable, each at most once; no runtime callbacks

entity.identity: one declared String identity field; Bool identity is rejected by the checked field model; branded immutable identity after successful validation
entity.equality_and_hash: concept and typed identity only, excluding other fields
entity.transition: owned previous snapshot and full next fields; reject changed identity after validators; previous remains immutable

value_object.equality_and_hash: complete name-sorted normalized typed tuple; direct component comparison, not serialization equality
